title: Unity in Diversity
definition: Unity in Diversity is the Church's calling to live as one body while honoring the different gifts, backgrounds, and roles God has given.
summary: Unity in Diversity teaches that Christ makes one body from believers with different gifts, backgrounds, cultures, abilities, and roles.
christFocus: Jesus Christ breaks down dividing walls and forms one new people through His cross.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Unity in diversity means the church is one body made of people with different gifts, backgrounds, cultures, weaknesses, and callings. Scripture celebrates diversity when it is submitted to one Lord and one Gospel.

This is not the same as vague tolerance or unity without truth. Biblical diversity is beautiful because Christ makes different people one without erasing God's wise design in them.

Jesus reconciles people to God and to one another through the cross. In Him, differences become opportunities for mutual honor rather than division.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches often pressure people to become culturally alike before they feel accepted. Unity in diversity corrects favoritism, superiority, and shame by showing that Christ's body needs many kinds of members.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Honor believers who are different from you in background, ability, age, story, or gifting. Refuse cliques and partiality, and look for ways different members can serve together under the same Gospel.
